hook: Apple is rethinking Mac permissions for AI agents.
hookText: Apple rethinks Mac permissions for AI

beats.say: AI agents like Meta's Muse request extraordinary access: messages, email, photos, browsing history, and then act on your behalf.
One user, Matt Robb, found Muse had been given permission to send messages containing his home address to strangers.
On November 16, Apple announced macOS 27.3 beta 2: where supported, you can pick exactly which protected folders an app may access, instead of all or nothing.
